markdown_content: ## Breast Shape Customization in CLO Avatar Editor This section explains the new breast shaping feature in the CLO avatar editor, detailing how users can customize breast shape, spacing, and height to create more realistic avatars. It also covers compatibility with the soft body avatar system and how measurements adjust dynamically with shape changes. ### Overview of Breast Shaping Features The avatar editor in CLO now includes a dedicated **Breasts** section under the **Shaping** category, allowing users to modify breast shape for greater realism and personalization. This feature works seamlessly with the **soft body avatar** system; when breast shape adjustments are made and soft body physics are enabled, the changes are reflected dynamically. ### Breast Shape Options: Round vs. Teardrop Users can choose between two primary breast shapes: - **Round**: A more spherical, ball-like breast shape. - **Teardrop**: A shape with a slight taper pointing upward, resembling a teardrop. A slider allows blending between these two shapes for subtle or pronounced effects, enabling customization based on user preference or realistic body representation. ### Spacing Adjustment The spacing control modifies the horizontal distance between the breasts, with settings for: - **Narrow spacing**: Breasts positioned closely together. - **Medium spacing**: Moderate separation. - **Wide spacing**: Larger gap between breasts. This allows fine-tuning of breast placement on the avatar’s chest for more accurate or preferred body proportions. ### Height Adjustment Height controls the vertical position of the breasts on the torso, simulating effects such as gravity or natural anatomical variation. Users can raise or lower the breasts on the avatar’s body to reflect different natural breast positions. ### Interaction with Measurements and Shaping When adjusting breast shape, corresponding measurements such as: - **Apex to Apex** (distance between the highest points of each breast) - **High Point Shoulder to Apex** (vertical distance from shoulder to breast apex) update dynamically on-screen to reflect the current shape settings. If users input their own specific breast measurements manually, the shaping will alter the breast shape but **will not change the user-entered measurements**. This may create discrepancies between the displayed measurements and the actual shape, as the avatar adjusts to meet the shape preferences while preserving the numerical measurement data. ### Managing Measurement Discrepancies - The system retains user-entered measurements as primary data. - Shaping changes may require the avatar’s body or breast geometry to adjust to visually match shape preferences. - Discrepancies between measurement values and visual shape are indicated to the user. - Users can toggle measurement display on or off. - Unchecking measurement inputs allows the shaping adjustments to directly modify measurements again. This approach ensures that users have access to both precise measurement data and flexible shaping options, supporting accurate avatar fitting and realistic modeling. --- ## Summary The CLO avatar editor’s new breast customization tools provide detailed control over breast shape, spacing, and height, integrated with both measurement inputs and soft body physics. This allows users to create highly personalized and realistic avatars, balancing exact measurements with natural shape variations and visual preferences.
